predeclared_questions: Q1 Reynolds number of the real construct vs the simulated object
Q2 which of the six gaits are time-reciprocal
Q3 does the dry-friction ranking survive the regime change (predeclared: NO)
Q4 is the quasi-static assumption satisfied (declared gate tau/T <= 1e-2)

reynolds_map.definition: Re = rho * U * L / mu, translational Reynolds number

anchors.source: Gumuskaya et al. 2023 Adv Sci 11:e2303575 (PMID 38032125), abstract: diameters 30-500 um, speeds 5-50 um/s

simulated_object_regime.what: the voxel-actuation artifact's body, at ITS OWN simulated size and speed, IF it were in water
simulated_object_regime.caveat: the artifact has NO fluid. It is dry Coulomb friction on a rigid floor plus a numerical absolute-frame damping term. This Re is a scale comparison, not a property of that simulation.
simulated_object_regime.oscillatory_definition: Re_omega = rho * omega * L^2 / mu, the frequency Reynolds number used by Lauga 2007 for reciprocal-stroke breakdown
simulated_object_regime.speed_definition: U is PATH LENGTH divided by the measurement window: 0.016124646 m / 1.25 s = 12.90 mm/s. Using the NET displacement instead gives 0.014577281 m / 1.25 s = 11.66 mm/s and Re = 581 rather than 643. Both are stated so a recomputation does not look like a discrepancy; path length is the right choice here because Re is about the speed at which the body moves through the fluid, not about how far it ends up from where it started.

reciprocity.method: T(t) = sin(wt) u + cos(wt) v with u=cos(phi), v=sin(phi); the control traces a closed curve in span{u,v}; rank <= 1 means a retraced segment, i.e. time-reciprocal
reciprocity.why: five of the six patterns assign only the phases 0 and pi, so every voxel's temperature is +/- A sin(wt): the whole body is driven by ONE scalar in time and the shape sequence is a path retraced in reverse. Only 'travelling' uses phi = 2 pi x / nx, which gives five distinct phases.

quasistatic_margin.why_it_matters: the reciprocity result above is about the CONTROL T_i(t). It transfers to the SHAPE only if the body's elastic response has no spatially varying phase lag. A flexible body whose elastic relaxation time is comparable to the drive period CAN swim on a reciprocal control (the elastohydrodynamic escape from the scallop theorem), so this gate is load-bearing.

real_tissue_estimate.status: E_Pa is ASSUMED (order-of-magnitude soft tissue); not measured here

fluid_driven_deformation_number.definition: mu * omega / E, the ratio of viscous stress from the surrounding water to the body's elastic stress
fluid_driven_deformation_number.reading: both are many orders below 1, so the surrounding water cannot appreciably deform the body and the shape follows the imposed rest sizes quasi-statically

stokes_ranking.model: RPY bead swimmer, 45 beads of radius s/2 at the voxel centres, shapes from a quasi-static free-floating elastic relaxation of the same actuation law

dry_friction_ranking.source: artifacts/voxel-actuation/summary.json arm_A, read not recomputed; and reproduced bit-for-bit here for travelling (0.0145773 m)

M2_longitudinal_plus_phase_gradient.must: become non-zero (it is now non-reciprocal); proves the zeros are not a solver that always returns zero

M3_free_draining_no_hydrodynamic_interac.must: give 0 for every gait: a free-draining body cannot swim

M4_time_reversed_travelling.must: flip sign exactly (kinematic reversibility of Stokes flow)

stokes_analytic_controls.SP2_note: Najafi-Golestanian three-sphere swimmer. We check the SCALING exponents (proportional to a, to d1, to d2, and to L^-2) rather than a prefactor, because we did not retrieve the published prefactor's full text. Deviations of a few percent are the expected finite-amplitude correction at d/L = 0.1.

stokes_invariance_checks.expectation: Stokes flow is linear and has no intrinsic scale, so displacement per cycle in BODY LENGTHS must be independent of absolute size, of viscosity and of frequency. Sensitivity to k2_ratio is the lattice's elastic-constant dependence and is reported, not suppressed.

stokes_shape_tolerance_refinement.why: the five reciprocal gaits must give EXACTLY zero. What the solver returns for them is the numerical residue of an iterative elastic relaxation, not a displacement. This arm separates the two: tighten the shape solve and a residue falls while a real displacement does not.
stokes_shape_tolerance_refinement.reading: travelling is stable to four significant figures across four decades of tolerance; the three reciprocal gaits fall by three to four orders of magnitude, tracking the tolerance, and floor near 1e-8 where double precision runs out. The reciprocal gaits' values are therefore reported as ZERO TO THE PRECISION OF THE SHAPE SOLVE and MUST NOT be ranked against each other.

ranking_comparison.spearman_caveat: computed over all six, but FIVE of the six Stokes values are numerical zero, so their relative order is meaningless and this coefficient is reported only to show that a naive correlation looks reassuring while the underlying comparison is vacuous. It is not evidence of transfer.
ranking_comparison.verdict: the dry-friction ranking does NOT transfer. Its 2nd and 3rd places (longitudinal 0.1532 BL, lateral 0.1412 BL) are both time-reciprocal and give exactly zero in the Stokes limit. Only the 1st place, travelling, survives the regime change.

headline: A millimetre-scale living construct sits at Reynolds number below 0.1, and five of the six published actuation patterns are time-reciprocal, so Purcell's scallop theorem makes their net displacement exactly zero there. The published gait ranking does not transfer: its 2nd and 3rd places are both dead in the regime the real object occupies, and only the travelling wave survives.

the_simulated_object_is_also_the_wrong_S.why_this_is_worth_stating_beside_the_Rey: Re = 643 is an abstraction. The plain fact underneath it is checkable from the committed candidate file and may land harder: the simulated body is 40-50 mm and a real construct is 0.5-1 mm, so the artifact simulates an object roughly 40 to 100 times too large, quite apart from having no fluid in it.
the_simulated_object_is_also_the_wrong_S.real_source: Gumuskaya et al. 2023 (PMID 38032125) report anthrobot diameters of 30-500 um; 1 mm is the nominal xenobot figure and is ASSUMED, not read from a paper

the_spearman_trap.what: A rank correlation between the two regimes' gait orderings returns rho = 0.943 with p = 0.005, which reads as excellent transfer.
the_spearman_trap.why_it_is_vacuous: five of the six Stokes values are the same number - exactly zero - so their relative order carries no information at all. The coefficient is computed over a tie that the test treats as a ranking.
the_spearman_trap.why_it_is_worth_its_own_section: this is a statistic reporting excellent agreement at the exact moment agreement has failed completely, and failed QUALITATIVELY rather than by degree. Anyone checking 'did the ranking transfer?' with a rank correlation would conclude that it did.
the_spearman_trap.what_to_do_instead: ask how many of the ranked items are distinguishable at all before ranking them. Here the answer is one, and the comparison should never have been posed as a correlation.

model.what_it_is: two models and one exact classification. (1) A closed-form Reynolds-number evaluation. (2) An exact algebraic test of whether each published actuation pattern is time-reciprocal. (3) A Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa bead-model Stokes swimmer over shapes from a quasi-static, free-floating, central-force spring lattice driven by the same actuation law.
model.not_voxelyze: the Stokes swimmer is OUR code and is not Voxelyze. Voxelyze at its pin is used unmodified for the dry-friction comparison, and reproduces the published travelling-wave run bit-for-bit at 0.0145773 m against 0.014577281 m.

parameters.name: k2_ratio
parameters.source: our choice: the face-diagonal spring stiffness relative to the nearest-neighbour one, which is what makes the lattice shear-stable. A nearest-neighbour-only cubic lattice has zero shear modulus and is a mechanism, not a solid. The Stokes result moves by under 1% across a 4x change in it.

limitations: The scallop-theorem result applies to a FREE SWIMMER. A construct crawling on a dish with its ventral surface in contact is not one: contact friction is not Stokes drag and is outside the theorem's assumptions, so a reciprocal gait can rectify against a surface. Kriegman et al. 2020 state their deciliated organisms 'always kept part of their ventral surfaces in contact with the surface of the dish due to negative buoyancy'.

Most published constructs are cilia-driven, and cilia are a SURFACE thrust mechanism, not a body gait. Kriegman et al. 2021's own simulation models them as an impulse force on each surface voxel. Our analysis bears directly on the 2020 cardiac-driven constructs, which do deform, and only indirectly on the cilia-driven ones.

The reciprocity test is exact for the CONTROL sequence. Carrying it to the SHAPE needs quasi-static response, which we check numerically rather than assume. The gate is met but only by a factor of 2.5 to 7 on the elastic-relaxation ratio, not by orders of magnitude; the fluid-driven deformation number mu*omega/E is the one that clears by many orders.

The elastic lattice is central-force, so it obeys the Cauchy relations and its Poisson ratio is a property of the spring topology rather than an input. We measure 0.20 against the artifact's 0.35, and its axial and bending effective moduli differ by about 2x. It is used only to generate a shape.
The reciprocal gaits return 1e-7 to 1e-8 rather than literal zero, which is the numerical residue of an iterative shape solve, not a displacement. Their relative order carries no information.
Water at 20 C is assumed for every fluid property. Real media differ, and a non-Newtonian medium would partially lift the scallop-theorem constraint (Qiu et al. 2014, PMID 25369018).
The Reynolds number for the simulated artifact body is a SCALE COMPARISON. That simulation contains no fluid at all.
what_this_cannot_establish: that any real construct would or would not move; no organism was measured
a corrected gait ranking for a surface crawler, which is a different problem
anything about cilia-driven propulsion, whose stroke we did not model
that the travelling wave is buildable: no living construct has per-region actuation phase control

not_diverged_gate.what: every Voxelyze run behind these studies is checked for divergence. Voxelyze's doTimeStep returns false when any link's axial strain exceeds 100; the driver records that as diverged and exits 3. A diverged run is not evidence and none is used.
not_diverged_gate.note: regime-check's own Stokes and elastic solves are not time-stepped and cannot diverge; their analogue is the minimiser-convergence flag in elastic_lattice_controls and the shape-solve tolerance refinement arm.
